text: As an environmental engineer, business owner, and mom I understand the challenges facing families in the Santa Clarita Valley: balancing a budget, keeping our kids healthy, and planning for the future. I am running for re-election to ensure our water remains safe, reliable, and affordable.

During my time on the board, I have prioritized fiscal responsibility, ensuring our long-term rate plans remain predictable for local families and small businesses. We have successfully expanded our state-of-the-art water treatment facilities, guaranteeing the water flowing into our homes and schools is pristine and safe.
My focus for the next term is clear:

Ensuring every drop we serve is healthy for all.
-

Protecting your household budget from unnecessary spikes.
-

Investing in local groundwater and infrastructure so we are drought-resilient without burdensome mandates.
-
Making sure you know exactly how and why decisions are made.

The Santa Clarita Valley is our home. We need a water board that works quietly, efficiently, and for you. I humbly ask for your vote to continue protecting our community's most essential resource. Let's keep our valley's water secure for our future.
www.ElectMaria.com

text: As a previously elected water board member and public advocate with 30 years of local and statewide water experience, Lynne is a voice you can trust.

She voted to:
- Ensure honest water supply reporting
- Cleanup ground water/polluters pay
- Purchase a solar farm/protect against energy shutoffs
- Protect the Santa Clara River
- Expand recycled water
- Enhance transparency
SHE VOTED

Water Supply Goals:
- Increase recycled water
- Protect current residents
- Development must pay its own way8
Long term sustainability is imperative to safeguard our community. Climate change must be considered in all decisions.

Lynne promotes open, honest government
- Meeting accessibility
- Fiscal responsibility/lower rates
- Water supply reporting must be honest – not over stated

Previously Held Positions:
- Alternate Board member, SCV Groundwater Sustainability Agency
- Member, Association of Water Agencies, Groundwater Committee
- Member, Association of Water Agencies, Water Quality Committee
- B.A. California State University Northridge, graduate work in business
- Retired business owner – no ties to or money from corporate interests
She is a non-profit executive Board member with vision, operational and fundraising experience.
A Board member must provide oversight of the public's business and the taxpayers' money. Lynne's business and water background uniquely qualify her to provide this oversight.
